name: Specialization: Moonbeam
description: Once per session, you can conjure a column of moonlight that illuminates the area within Close range until the end of the scene. While bathed in this moonlight, you and any allies gain a +1 bonus to Spellcast Rolls and advantage on rolls to see through illusions.
